page: Microsoft Azure NC72ds_xl_RTXPRO6000BSE_v6 is a GPU-accelerated virtual machine based on the x86_64 architecture and powered by Intel processors. Running on the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor, the instance supplies 72 dedicated vCPUs and 264.0 GB of system memory, which establishes an allocation of approximately 3.67 GB of RAM per vCPU.

Hardware acceleration is delivered via a 0.5 fractional instance of an NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000 GPU from the Blackwell family, providing 48 GB of VRAM. For high-speed temporary I/O operations, the configuration includes 3986 GB of local NVMe SSD storage and supports Azure Premium Storage. The instance does not include complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

By pairing a high core count with a fractional GPU profile, this configuration offers resource efficiency for compute-heavy pipelines that require workstation-class graphical or matrix acceleration without requiring a full dedicated GPU board. It is suitable for GPU-accelerated data processing, machine learning inference, computer-aided engineering, 3D visualization, and local scratch disk-intensive batch tasks.
description: Microsoft Azure NC72ds_xl_RTXPRO6000BSE_v6 is a specialized GPU-accelerated instance designed for high-density compute and accelerated processing. Built on an x86_64 Intel processor running on Microsoft Hyper-V, the configuration provides 72 dedicated vCPUs and 264.0 GB of memory, yielding 3.67 GB of RAM per vCPU. Hardware acceleration is provided by a partitioned NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000 GPU from the Blackwell family, offering a 0.5 GPU allocation and 48 GB of dedicated video memory. High-throughput local scratch space is supplied by an integrated 3986 GB NVMe SSD, complemented by support for Premium Storage. The partitioning of the GPU alongside a high CPU-to-GPU core ratio provides qualitative cost efficiency for resource-heavy workloads that need hardware acceleration without monopolizing an entire physical GPU adapter. Primary workload fits include GPU-accelerated simulation, AI inference, 3D visualization, video rendering pipelines, and data processing requiring fast local storage.
